descriptionMarkdown:
I found out that you can build custom music. Found the fun book, and spent a week compiling touhou midis and converting/tweaking them using the amazing miditorio website. List is below. I tried to make them sound as close as possible to the original ZUN. Most of the midis are from https://gamebanana.com/projects/35179 bless them.

Enjoy~~ HakureiSmugfest

btw the clipboard is big be prepared for some lag

Recommended to lower "alerts" volume.

7/22/2021 -- There are so many nice songs. added more th16 and 7.5, and that one american fairy theme.

8/17/2021 -- Updated to version1.0+. Added th17 and th18. Put some flavor text in descriptions, and some directions for circuits. Let me know if there's any problem below in disqus, or in reddit u/needsmorebaka, thanks and have fun!

1/14/2022 -- New loop blueprint for multiple players. Meaning, a playlist! No more hands needed. Some people ask me why I play factorio like this. I answer, touhou music is just that good.
title: Touhou MIDI 【東方Project】
